groups.operation: Unpack a typed object member and report its error through an unpack error destination.
groups.condition: A string format selects a non-string object member.
groups.capability: json_unpack_ex can report the member key in the wrong-type diagnostic.
groups.consequence: The keyed diagnostic is unavailable through the entry's generic o format and json_unpack call.
groups.equivalence_reason: All four target the same new key-bearing diagnostic for a typed member mismatch.

groups.operation: Unpack an object member with a string value format.
groups.condition: The selected member is not a string.
groups.capability: The string format rejects the member's type; {s?o} selects generic o instead.
groups.consequence: The wrong-type member is not rejected by string validation.
groups.equivalence_reason: These target the same object-member type check, independent of diagnostic wording.

groups.operation: Unpack an array element with i.
groups.condition: The selected element is not an integer.
groups.capability: i rejects the element's type; [o!] selects generic o instead.
groups.consequence: The non-integer element is not rejected by integer validation.
groups.equivalence_reason: Its array element and integer condition differ from the other typed-format claims.

groups.capability: Object unpacking rejects a missing required member; ? makes data optional.
groups.consequence: The missing data member is not rejected as required.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both target the same missing-member check and optional-marker constraint.

groups.condition: The object contains a member unconsumed by the format.
groups.capability: An object ! marker or strict unpack flag enables rejection; {s?o} and json_unpack do not enable it.
groups.consequence: The extra object member is not rejected by strict object validation.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three target strict rejection of unconsumed object members.

groups.operation: Extract or validate a scalar through a typed unpack format.
groups.condition: A scalar value is selected with a typed format.
groups.capability: Formats s, i, I, b, f, F, and n select typed scalar behavior; the entry selects o.
groups.consequence: Typed scalar extraction or validation is not reached.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same general typed-scalar dispatch gap.

groups.operation: Recursively unpack a nested object or array.
groups.condition: A selected member or element contains a nested structure.
groups.capability: Nested object or array formats descend into the value; o returns the value without descending.
groups.consequence: Recursive unpacking of the nested value is not reached.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both target recursive format dispatch for nested values.

groups.operation: Extract a JSON value with the O unpack format.
groups.condition: A valid selected value is unpacked with O.
groups.capability: O acquires a retained reference that must be released; the entry selects borrowed o.
groups.consequence: Retained-reference extraction and its ownership behavior are not reached.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both target the same O-format reference ownership contract.
